_metadata.purpose: Block h901 MeSH mappings that resolve to symptom/sign/finding-level MeSH descriptors (tree C23 or generic), not treatable diseases.
_metadata.method: MeSH tree-number classification via NCBI MeSH API. Blocks any name whose mapped MeSH descriptor's tree(s) are entirely in C23 (Pathological Conditions, Signs and Symptoms) AND has no treatable disorder semantics.
kept_with_note: anorexia (megestrol/cyproheptadine treat appetite loss; weak indication)
recurrent depression (antidepressants — though MeSH points to symptom-level Depression D003863; should remap to D003866 Depressive Disorder)
emphysema, chronic emphysema (real subtype of COPD; bronchodilators legitimately indicated)
hyperuricemia, asymptomatic hyperuricemia (allopurinol/febuxostat treat — direct indication)
acute hyperammonemia (treated by sodium phenylbutyrate, lactulose — direct)
acute rejection (graft rejection — immunosuppressants directly indicated)
allergy (mismapped to medication class D26.310.500; should be remapped not blocked)
